description: Enterprise techniques used by TWOSTROKE, ATT&CK software S9067 (v1.0)
name: TWOSTROKE (S9067)

techniques.comment: [TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has encoded its payloads with hex and separates values with `@##@`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has utilized SSL encrypted C2 over TCP port 443.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) can exfiltrate data over C2.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has the ability list the directory.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has been deployed using DLL search order hijacking.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has the ability to delete files.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has downloaded files from C2.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)

[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has leveraged Windows API calls to gather system information using `GetComputerNameExW(ComputerNameDnsFullyQualified)`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has encrypted gathered device data with XOR and a static key.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has utilized valid digital signatures to evade detection from security tools.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has gathered victim hostname and the domain through `GetComputerNameExW(ComputerNameDnsFullyQualified)`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TWOSTROKE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9067) has gathered the full victim name.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
